description: Every widget in one project, published or not, with its full settings as the editor holds them: addresses, ports, channels, MIDI mappings, DMX targets. Also says where the project is published, if it is. A setting nobody touched reads as its default. What phones see is the published copy, which may be older: read_published reads that one.

project.description: The project's id, or its title, as list_projects gives them

name: read_project
title: A project's widgets
